title: Buckeye On the Beach | KEY.co
description_expanded: Descend to the tranquil second level where privacy and serenity are paramount. The master suite, adorned with a king-sized bed and a spa-like ensuite bathroom, offers direct access to a private porch overlooking the Gulf of Mexico—perfect for peaceful morning reflections or evening relaxation. Additional sleeping quarters include a queen-sized guest room with an ensuite bath and a charming bunk room ideal for younger guests or extra family members. Each space is meticulously crafted to enhance your stay, from the dual laundry areas to the additional outdoor seating on the screened-in back porch. As a bonus, guests can explore Seaside’s quaint boutiques, eateries, and entertainment options on complimentary bikes, making every day an adventure in this picturesque locale. Immerse yourself in the coastal splendor of this luxurious beachfront home, a masterpiece of design and comfort located just steps from the charming center of Seaside town. Offering three expansive levels of living space, this haven combines elegance with a touch of seaside chic. The heart of the home is found on the third floor, where an open-concept layout includes a cozy sitting area, a fireplace, and a state-of-the-art kitchen equipped with top-of-the-line appliances like a Sub-Zero refrigerator and Thermador cooking tools. Large, wall-mounted flat-screen TVs and plush seating ensure every moment inside is enveloped in comfort and luxury. Step outside onto the stunning porch for al fresco dining or to simply soak in the panoramic views of the Emerald Coast.
